from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # |00> -> H on qubit 0 -> (|00>+|01>)/sqrt2
    qc.h(0)
    # CNOT 0 -> 1 -> (|00>+|11>)/sqrt2
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    # flip sign of |11>
    qc.z(1)   # Z on either qubit gives the same |00> - |11> up to global phase
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # |00> --H0--> (|00>+|01>)/sqrt2
    # Z on the control puts a minus on the |01> term
    qc.h(0)
    qc.z(0)
    # CNOT maps |01> -> |11>, giving (|00>-|11>)/sqrt2
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    return qc
